title: Customer onramp sprint 42 checkpoint brief
content:
Weekly checkpoint: Solutions / ProServices customer onramp (Sprint 42) — 2027-07-21

Attendees:
- Maya Chen (SE lead)
- Liam O'Connor (Field Eng)
- Priya Nair (SRE liaison)
- Diego Alvarez (Integration Eng)
- Janelle Park (Customer PM)
- Customer-side contacts: SolacePay (Elena Ruiz), BlueMantle (Owen Park), CitrineData (S. Kim)

Goals for this checkpoint:
- Triage open integration risk per customer and assign clear owners.
- Confirm canary rollout schedule and rollback plan for each account.
- Validate KV cache priming strategy (first-request latency targets).
- Surface infra requests for Dedicated/private network changes to platform-eng.

Summary (top line):
- SolacePay: On track for canary tomorrow (2027-07-22) but needs final KV cache priming script and SRE window for traffic shaping. Medium risk.
- BlueMantle: Blocked on model variant compatibility — quantized 4-bit runtime produces elevated hallucination rate on domain prompts. Need eval-run and decision before canary. High risk.
- CitrineData: Data migration in progress (schema alignment done), finished smoke tests against Redwood Private on customer infra. Low risk but needs documentation signoff.

Per-customer notes and actions:
1) SolacePay (primary integration: payments conversational assistance)
   - Status: Canary ready pending cache priming + burst throttle window.
   - Technical details: Using hosted-inference (dedicated pool) with 16-token average replies, model variant: rwd-clarity-13B-quant. TTL and KV cache set at 36h but we want priming to reduce first-token P95 from 620ms -> <220ms.
   - Blockers: Need SRE to open a 2-hour traffic shaping window (2027-07-22 02:00-04:00 PST) and approve canary ramp policy.
   - Actions:
     * Diego to deliver cache priming script and sample payloads by EOD 2027-07-21. (owner: Diego Alvarez)
     * Priya to request SRE window and prepare rollback runbook. (owner: Priya Nair, due: 2027-07-21 18:00)
     * Maya to validate metrics dashboard (latency/cost per-token) and confirm alert thresholds. (owner: Maya Chen)
   - Risk: Medium — SRE window dependency, otherwise infra/profiles already provisioned.

2) BlueMantle (retail catalog summarization + search reranking)
   - Status: Paused; data shows increased hallucinations with quantized runtime variant.
   - Technical details: Candidate model rwd-slim-7B-q4f16. Customer test prompts highlighted entity hallucination in ~2.8% of responses vs baseline 0.4% on full-precision run.
   - Blockers: Need a quick A/B eval across 1200 prompts, plus a short prompt engineering pass (guardrails, canonicalization) before production traffic.
   - Actions:
     * Liam to run 1k prompt eval on rwd-slim-7B-q4f16 and upload results to Confluence. (owner: Liam O'Connor, due: 2027-07-23)
     * SE + Product to propose two immediate mitigation patterns: response-shot validation and reranker fallback. (owner: Maya & Product eng, due: 2027-07-24)
     * If quantized variant cannot meet quality SLO, propose fallback to rwd-slim-7B-fp16 with cost note. (owner: Solutions)
   - Risk: High — quality regression blocks any canary rollout.

3) CitrineData (analytics summarization, private deployment)
   - Status: Migration of historical prompts complete; smoke tests passed on Redwood Private in customer VPC.
   - Technical details: On-prem control plane with HSM key management; autoscaling policy tuned to 2x baseline. KV cache TTL conservative (48h) for auditability.
   - Blockers: Documentation signoff and legal checklist (SOC2 additional fields) outstanding.
   - Actions:
     * Janelle to collect legal signoff checklist items and route to security/compliance. (owner: Janelle Park, due: 2027-07-26)
     * Diego to finalize runbook for private upgrade procedure (owner: Diego Alvarez, due: 2027-07-25)
   - Risk: Low — mostly paperwork and final docs.

Cross-cutting issues and infra asks:
- SRE: Need explicit approval for traffic shaping windows and a standby runbook during SolacePay canary. (Priya to coordinate.)
- Platform: Requesting a temporary Dedicated pool capacity bump (2 nodes) for SolacePay canary (ticket: JIRA-ONRAMP-4991). Platform eng to confirm by EOD 2027-07-21.
- Observability: Add a transient dashboard for SolacePay with: per-route P50/P95 latency, cache-hit ratio, model-variant tag, and per-token cost. (owner: Maya / Observability team)

Operational runbook notes (short-form):
- Canary ramp plan (SolacePay): 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 2 hours with manual pause points. Rollback: disable routing and divert to warm standby FP16 variant; alert thresholds: latency P95 > 600ms or error rate > 0.75%.
- Cache priming: run 3 parallel priming jobs (unique prefixes) to warm KV shards; validate cache-hit ratio > 80% within 15 minutes.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Proceed with SolacePay canary tomorrow contingent on SRE window and cache script validation.
- Postpone BlueMantle canary until eval results and mitigation patterns complete.
- CitrineData to proceed to documentation signoff step; no changes to technical plan.

Open questions / items to escalate:
- Product: should we require per-customer quality gates for any quantized model variant or treat on case-by-case? (Action: Product to clarify policy by 2027-07-24)
- Legal/Security: confirm whether CitrineData's HSM setup requires additional audit steps beyond SOC2 addendum. (Action: Security to respond by 2027-07-25)

Loose notes / scratchpad (raw):
- Cache priming sample payloads: payment intents + 3-turn convo with user locale tokens. Keep anonymized.
- Consider short-term fallback toggle in SDK (client-side) to route critical requests to FP16 if quality dips.
- Slack channel thread for SolacePay: #onramp-solacepay (link above).

Next meeting cadence:
- Rapid follow-up (SolacePay only) Tues 2027-07-22 04:30 PST (post-canary debrief).
- Full weekly checkpoint: Thu 2027-07-29 09:00 PST.

Owner summary (quick):
- Diego Alvarez: Deliver cache priming script + private runbook.
- Priya Nair: SRE window request, standby runbook.
- Liam O'Connor: Quantized eval for BlueMantle.
- Janelle Park: Legal signoff collection for CitrineData.
- Maya Chen: Dashboard + overall integration lead.

Attachments & artifacts:
- Link to priming script (draft): github.com/redwood-inference/onramp/priming/solacepay (PR #872).
- Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ONRAMP-42
- Jira tickets: JIRA-ONRAMP-4982, JIRA-ONRAMP-4991

Notes on doc hygiene: this is a working checkpoint doc; will convert to a one-pager for customer handoff after SolacePay canary completes.

-- end of checkpoint brief --
